annotations.title: Submit Tracked Async Document Extraction Job

description: Create a tracked extraction job (`jobId`) for custom-schema JSON extraction with optional HTTP webhook delivery (`POST` callback with `{jobId, status, data}`), persisted so results can be retrieved via `get_document_job`. Requires a valid `api_key` (max 5 MB document size; deducts 1 credit per page upon completion). Use for asynchronous, persisted, or webhook-driven workflows; for immediate inline extraction without creating a stored job record, use `extract_document_json` instead.

api_key.description: Smart OCR API key (`ocr-tok_...`). Required unless already supplied via the `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer` request header.

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded document bytes (raw base64 or `data:<mime>;base64,...` URI, max 5 MB decoded). Mutually exclusive with `file_url` — provide exactly one.

file_url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL of the PDF, PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or TIFF document (max 5 MB). Mutually exclusive with `file_base64` — provide exactly one.

schema.description: Non-empty target JSON template or JSON Schema describing the fields to extract.

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint to receive the completion POST payload (`{jobId, status, data}`). Falls back to the default webhook configured on the API key, or to Smart OCR internal job storage for polling via `get_document_job`.

name: submit_document_job

jobId.description: Unique job identifier to pass to `get_document_job` to retrieve status and extracted data.

message.description: Human-readable summary of job execution and webhook dispatch.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the submitted extraction job.
